SELECT 'cal' k, fiscal_period_label, MIN(period_start_date) a, MAX(period_end_date) b, MAX(CAST(fully_loaded AS INT)) fl FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'sales', 'rows', MIN(sale_date), MAX(sale_date), COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2026-08-31'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dups', 'sales_line_id dup', NULL, NULL, COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2026-08-31'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dups2', 'receipt+line dup', NULL, NULL, COUNT(*) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2026-08-31')) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2026-08-31'
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
    SELECT business_date, store_id, SUM(net_sales) ns FROM net_lines
    WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-30' GROUP BY 1,2
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT business_date, store_id, net_sales ns FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
    WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-30'
)
SELECT 'P5' k, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.business_date<=DATE '2026-09-27' THEN m.ns END),2) mine, (SELECT ROUND(SUM(ns),2) FROM ctl WHERE business_date<=DATE '2026-09-27') ctl_all,
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.business_date<=DATE '2026-09-27' AND m.store_id<900 THEN m.ns END),2) mine_st,
 (SELECT ROUND(SUM(ns),2) FROM ctl WHERE business_date<=DATE '2026-09-27' AND store_id<900) ctl_st,
 (SELECT ROUND(SUM(ns),2) FROM ctl WHERE business_date<=DATE '2026-09-27' AND store_id=900) ctl_web,
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.business_date<=DATE '2026-09-27' AND m.store_id=900 THEN m.ns END),2) mine_web
FROM mine m
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Sep', ROUND(SUM(m.ns),2), (SELECT ROUND(SUM(ns),2) FROM ctl),
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.store_id<900 THEN m.ns END),2),
 (SELECT ROUND(SUM(ns),2) FROM ctl WHERE store_id<900),
 (SELECT ROUND(SUM(ns),2) FROM ctl WHERE store_id=900),
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.store_id=900 THEN m.ns END),2)
FROM mine m

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.category, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.category, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
),
mine AS (
    SELECT business_date, store_id, SUM(net_sales) ns FROM net_lines
    WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND store_id<>999 AND category<>'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT 'daystore_mismatch' k, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(SUM(ABS(COALESCE(m.ns,0)-COALESCE(c.net_sales,0))),2) v
FROM mine m FULL JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales c ON c.business_date=m.business_date AND c.store_id=m.store_id
WHERE COALESCE(c.business_date,m.business_date) BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  AND ABS(COALESCE(m.ns,0)-COALESCE(c.net_sales,0))>0.005
UNION ALL
SELECT 'excluded_999_ZZ', COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(net_sales),2) FROM net_lines
WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND (store_id=999 OR category='ZZ Test')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_pending_or_cancelled_orders_in_P5', COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(order_total_gross),2) FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('processing','cancelled') AND order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-31'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_dispatched_P5_ordered_before', COUNT(*), NULL FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected') AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) < DATE '2026-08-31'

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
GROUP BY 1, 2
